entity.name: VoiceStudio
entity.description: Maintainers of VoiceStudio, the open-source, fully local voice cloning, voice design, dubbing and dictation app.

projects.name: VoiceStudio
projects.description: A free, fully local alternative to ElevenLabs: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing and real-time dictation across 646 languages on desktop and phone, with no accounts, API keys or cloud.
